name: Sting of the Scorpid

angles.text: As a young orc coming of age in the Valley of Trials, you face an essential test of endurance and battlefield awareness under Gornek's eye.
As a Darkspear troll training alongside the Horde in the Valley of Trials, you prove your skill against local scorpids before venturing deeper into Durotar.
As a warrior, you learn from Gornek that decisive strikes can overcome tough carapaces. Arrogance toward smaller foes invites defeat.

aliases: who gives sting of the scorpid
faq.answer: Gornek oversees novice training at the Den in the Valley of Trials. He assigns the hunt to young warriors and adventurers.
faq.q: Who assigns Sting of the Scorpid?

faq.answer: Scorpid workers roam northwest of the Den in the Valley of Trials.
Gornek requires ten Scorpid Worker Tails as proof that a recruit has faced the venomous beasts and won.
faq.q: What does Gornek require from the hunt?

faq.answer: The Den brews antivenom from venom extracted from scorpid stingers. It keeps stores on hand to treat novices who underestimate their prey.
faq.q: How is the antidote for scorpid venom created?

faq.answer: Gornek teaches recruits that any opponent, large or small, can be lethal. Overconfidence against a seemingly minor foe can prove fatal.
faq.q: What lesson does Gornek want recruits to learn?

aliases: what after sting of the scorpid
faq.answer: After you deliver the tails, Gornek says he has nothing left to teach you at the Den. He sends you onward into Durotar to serve the Horde.
faq.q: Does Gornek offer further training after this hunt?

sections.body: Gornek tests novice Horde recruits against the Valley of Trials' wildlife. Scorpid workers roam the rocks northwest of the Den. Their venom has humbled seasoned warriors and clumsy initiates alike. Recruits must face them and bring back ten tails as proof of their skill.
sections.title: Trial of the Stinger

sections.body: Scorpids are dangerous, yet their venom also helps save injured initiates. The Den keeps antivenom brewed from extracted scorpid venom to treat fallen novices. Gornek teaches recruits to stay watchful in battle. Even a small foe can wield enough venom to fell a mighty warrior.
sections.title: Venom and Vigilance

summary: At the Den in the Valley of Trials, Gornek sends new Horde recruits after scorpids northwest of camp. Ten tails will prove they can face danger in battle.
attribution: In-game quest text: Sting of the Scorpid
